releaseNotes:
## ✨ What's New

### 🤝 Meet Pips
- Create and manage a team of agents in the new Pips workspace, with individual avatars, identity colours, and status indicators.
- Give each Pip its own working folder, configure its identity and model, and control how it hands work to teammates.
- Choose agent roles from Agent Studio or the marketplace, or jump into Agent Studio to build a new agent.

### 💬 Team Channels and Deliverables
- Bring Pips together in persistent team channels, with mentions, replies, threads, progress updates, and stop controls.
- Delegate work between Pips through handoffs while keeping each teammate's agent session separate.
- Save and browse Pip deliverables locally, with version history.

### 🧰 More Control in Coding Mode
- Create, delete, and move files and folders within the authorized workspace, with safeguards for open files and unsaved changes.
- Use additional editor shortcuts, terminal paste controls, and terminal panel collapse, maximise, and restore actions.
- See changed-file counts alongside the Coding workspace's Git controls.

### 🧠 Clearer Memory Recall
- Read recalled memory topics directly in chat, with formatted Markdown, recall status, and copy actions.
- Keep raw memory tool requests and responses tucked away in technical details.

## 🛠️ Improvements
- Workflows are grouped into Installed and Not installed sections, with workflow tiles and clearer installation status.
- Retry loading the workflow list when a request fails.
- Pip chat navigation, conversation naming, deletion, and configuration have been refined.
- Voice input now uses tap-to-talk controls instead of hold-to-talk, with updated transcription, session limits, and availability handling.
- New Pips, workflow, and memory interfaces include localized messages across English, German, Spanish, and European Portuguese.

## 🐛 Bug Fixes
- Account language synchronization waits for startup authentication and avoids duplicate refreshes, while still refreshing after reconnecting.
- Realtime voice sessions use Compass-brokered connections, with stronger cleanup, recovery, and usage settlement handling.
- Pip channel cleanup handles settled handoffs before removing channel messages, and collaboration safeguards reduce duplicate handoffs.
- Utility views no longer show the chat sidebar panel; selecting a mode from a full-page view returns to chat.
- The sidebar footer logo is centered, and the obsolete tool-gallery registry-update banner has been removed.

## ⚙️ Under the Hood
- Added persistent storage and migrations for Pips, team channels, threads, teammates, and versioned deliverables.
- Expanded regression tests and packaged verification scripts for agent collaboration, deliverables, Coding interactions, memory recall, and account language synchronization.
- Updated the Electron packaging toolchain and dependencies, including Sharp, Mermaid, and Mammoth.
- Accepted the coding agents and worktrees architecture design; its proposed workspace is not included as a new feature in this release.
- Application version metadata was bumped to 1.0.21.

🛸 Co-authored with [Nova](https://www.compassap.ai/portfolio/nova.html)
